title: Chaglad Region
description: A land where anything is possible.
body:
A custom Server for friends, A place to travel and adventure and survive. Please be friendly and let's all have a good time together!

Cobblemon x Create and some other good little additions are part of this server.

Not against others joining to play but mostly built for family so if you do join please be kind and do not destroy or troll other players.
